diagnosis.summary: Run 292e7ff4 (partition 2026-10-01) failed in `transform` because fct_orders hit a Binder Error: it now selects `o.order_total` from stg_orders, which only has `order_amount`. That edit is the only difference from the deployed models. The upstream orders file and the ingest config haven't changed. I've proposed reverting fct_orders to the deployed version, which the harness will verify with a rerun.

root_cause.explanation: Someone edited fct_orders, but the edit isn't in the deployed version. It replaced `o.order_amount` with `o.order_total as order_amount`. Alias `o` is stg_orders, which renames raw order_total to order_amount, so `order_total` doesn't exist at the staging layer. That causes the Binder Error. The landing data matches the contract and the ingest config is empty, so this is a code regression, not upstream drift.

evidence.claim: The transform step failed because the fct_orders model errored with Binder Error: column order_total not found in 'o'
fct_orders is the only changed model. The edit replaced o.order_amount with o.order_total
stg_orders hasn't changed, and it exposes order_amount, not order_total
The landing orders file matches the contract and the ingest config is at defaults, so nothing changed upstream
The runbook says to revert the model that changed when a model error follows a deploy

alternatives_considered: Upstream column rename (apply_column_mapping): ruled out because the landing header and contract are identical and both have order_total
An upstream staging model changed: ruled out because stg_orders is unchanged and fct_orders is the only changed model

Escalating to analytics_engineering as an intentional logic change: not chosen because the edit can't run at all and renames the column to the same output name (order_amount), so it looks like a mistake rather than planned business logic
Transient failure / rerun_only: ruled out because the error is a deterministic binder error

proposal.rationale: fct_orders is the only model that differs from deployed; the undeployed edit replaced o.order_amount with o.order_total, a column that does not exist in stg_orders (stg_orders renames raw order_total to order_amount). Landing data and ingest config are unchanged, so this is a code regression, not upstream drift. Per runbook, revert the changed model.

applied: reverted models/marts/fct_orders.sql to the deployed version
